statements.t: Since 2023, direct-to-paid acquisition has accounted for approximately 48% - 58% of our annual Paid Subscriber acquisition, and is largely driven by display ads and targeted email campaigns.
Because of the quality of our products, we believe subscribers will stay with us and expand their subscriptions over time.

While we believe that Billings provides valuable insight into the cash that will be generated from sales of our subscriptions, this metric may vary from period to period for a number of reasons and, therefore, Billings have a number of limitations as a quarter-over-quarter or year-over-year comparative measure.
We expect Adjusted CFFO and Adjusted CFFO Margin to fluctuate in future periods as we invest in our business to execute our growth strategy.
The Company estimates that the amount of “float” was approximately $95.9 million and $98.2 million as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.

The investment allocation decisions are based in part on the anticipated liquidity requirements of the Company including working capital, estimated tax related distributions, and broader capital allocation objectives.
We expect that our anticipated operating cash flows, in addition to cash on hand, will enable us to continue to make investments in the future, and to pay dividends.
We expect our operating cash flows to further improve as we increase our operational efficiency and experience economies of scale.
Our continued declaration and payment of dividends and institution of any other distributions of capital to shareholders will be at the discretion of our Board.
There can be no assurance that we will continue to pay dividends in the future.

We expect to make payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement in future periods in connection with certain tax benefits realized by MarketWise, Inc. from exchanges of MarketWise, LLC units for shares of MarketWise, Inc.’s Class A common stock.
The Company expects to pay $0.6 million within the next twelve months.

Furthermore, to the extent we have taxable income, we will make distributions to the MarketWise Members and to MarketWise, Inc. in amounts sufficient for the recipients to pay taxes due on their share of MarketWise income at prevailing individual income tax rates.
We expect MarketWise, Inc. to continue receiving quarterly tax distributions in future quarters; however, the amount is uncertain.
We expect to continue to calculate and issue regular dividends using a methodology equivalent to historical total dividends, such that we expect no material change to our capital structure.

We believe that our existing cash and cash equivalents and cash flow from operations will be sufficient to support working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months.
Eifrig continued, “Our performance for the year is largely playing out as we expected.
“Regarding our financial guidance, we are affirming our FY 2026 Billings Target of approximately $330 million, which represents approximately a $59 million or 22% increase compared to FY 2025.
We are also affirming our FY 2026 CFFO Target of $50 million.
acquisition impacted CFFO in the first half of the year, our expectations for Q4 suggest that the CFFO Target remains achievable.

To this end, planning is well underway for FY 2027 and we are partnering closely with our Board to develop targets and strategies that align with our purpose of enhancing value for subscribers and all shareholders.
While targets, strategies, and budgets for FY 2027 are still being developed, we expect Billings growth to continue, coupled with meaningfully higher cash flow margins.
We look forward to providing updates as things progress.”
We expect this dynamic to occur during FY 2026 where GAAP Net Revenue will decline while customer sales activity and Billings increase.
However, as Billings tend to lead Net Revenue by 12-24 months, on average, we expect Net Revenue to stabilize in 2026 and return to growth in 2027.
Based on current projections of taxable income, we expect tax distributions in FY 2027 to decrease by a similar amount compared to FY 2026.
Our focus will continue to be on delivering high-quality products to our customers, in an efficient manner, which we believe will drive both top line growth and margin expansion over time.
Further, we intend to continue our disciplined approach to capital allocation with a mix of dividends, share repurchases, and prudent investments in our business.
